new_learnings.text: When the top-performing sectors are defensive groups like 航运港口、国有大型银行、白色家电 while all major indices are red, treat sector strength as relative defense rather than a green light for aggressive momentum buying.
new_learnings.mechanism: Defensive leadership during index-wide liquidation usually means capital is hiding, not broadly embracing risk, so stock-level breakouts have lower follow-through.

new_learnings.text: The MA-distance anti-chase rule remains crucial: many fundamentally attractive names today failed only because they are too far above MA10/MA20, which matters even more on a panic tape.
new_learnings.mechanism: In weak breadth, stretched names lose nearest support quickly, so overextension turns good stories into bad entries.

new_learnings.text: A panic breadth ratio below 0.3:1 with 0/3 major indices green should default the system to full cash, even if the candidate list still contains high-RPS names.
new_learnings.mechanism: Momentum edge comes from both stock strength and market sponsorship; when sponsorship disappears, stock selection quality cannot compensate for tape risk.
